title: WHAT IF EVERYONE COULD READ YOUR MIND? 🧠😱 (Animated Short Film)
description:
What if you woke up one morning and suddenly realized the walls of your own skull had dissolved? Every private thought, every intrusive impulse, and every secret judgment... broadcasting out loud to everyone around you.

Civilized society is held together by the polite lies we tell each other every single day. But when Pip's unfiltered mind leaks out in a crowded subway car, he faces the ultimate psychological nightmare. Can any human relationship survive radical, brutal honesty?
